goal: Prevent wallet data loss and corruption during legacy-to-descriptor wallet migration
Automatically restore the original wallet from backup if migration fails mid-process
agreement: Strong support because the original database is left untouched until migration succeeds (ryanofsky)
Open nonblocking suggestions on error handling contracts and unexpected file checks (ryanofsky)
Suggests indicating if database rename happened to prevent unnecessary backup restoration (w0xlt)

categories.name: wallet
why: P1 because it eliminates wallet corruption and data loss risks during migration to descriptor wallets
Mid-process failures or crashes previously left users with missing or unreadable wallet files
Users previously had to perform manual backup restoration after an unexpected migration failure
